location_and_environment: Candidate processing floor at the academy: survey cubicle warren, brass flag terminals, receipt printers, a guarded receipt-check gate (two soldier-built checkers with grease pencils), and the exit flow beyond.

characters_present.name: Britt
characters_present.status: finished her survey first; stalled via a fake printer malfunction (shell knocked over a typewriter); received an unusually warm, acknowledged welcome at the gate

characters_present.name: Aggie
characters_present.status: quiet, finished her survey late under cover of Britt's diversion; smiled at the timing

characters_present.name: Lomi
characters_present.status: chatty with attendants about benefits/union; boiler-maker family pride on display

characters_present.name: Iggy
characters_present.status: pulled down a receipt printer for a 'tissue'; escorted through by a supervisor; patted on the back by a gate guard

characters_present.name: Ignatius
characters_present.status: watching failed candidates get pulled aside with quiet unease ('why'd you make it so sad')

immediate_preceding_action: The party clears the receipt-check gauntlet and exits the testing floor; Britt was singled out for a warm, personal welcome by the gate guards.
emotional_tone_or_tension: Comic chaos covering a darker note — one in five candidates are quietly culled; Britt's special welcome hints she was noticed for a reason.
